description: This file defines an exception class for Zend Framework's HTTP UserAgent Features component, extending the base Zend_Http_UserAgent_Exception class. It includes licensing information, a requirement for another exception class, and the declaration of the exception class itself.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Features_Exception
classes.description: A custom exception class for the Zend HTTP UserAgent Features component, extending the general UserAgent exception class.
